'''Nelly Jeanne "Nell" Ginjaar-Maas''' (7 May 1931 – 24 April 2012) was a Dutch politician of the [[People's Party for Freedom and Democracy]] (VVD) and teacher.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.absolutefacts.nl/politiek/data/ginjaarl1928.htm|title=Leendert Ginjaar (1928-2003)|publisher=Absolutefacts.nl|date=15 May 2012|accessdate=9 December 2018|language=nl}}</ref>

Ginjaar-Maas was born in [[Rotterdam]], and was a member of the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]] for the People's Party for Freedom and Democracy for nine years. Ginjaar-Maas was married to minister [[Leendert Ginjaar]].<ref>{{cite book|title=Linguistics and language behavior abstracts: LLBA.|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=E1o8AQAAIAAJ|year=1993|publisher=Sociological Abstracts, Inc.|page=1442}}</ref> Ginjaar-Maas died on the island of [[Corsica]] on 24 April 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://nos.nl/artikel/365872-politica-ginjaarmaas-overleden.html |title=NOS Nieuws - Politica Ginjaar-Maas overleden |publisher=Nos.nl |date= 24 April 2012|accessdate=2012-04-26}}</ref>
